findings.title: Top Gross Profit Item: Item-Level Economics
findings.claim: The highest-margin item by absolute gross profit contribution is Chicken Sandwich (SKU: FOD-005), generating SAR 3370.00 gross profit from 207 units sold at SAR 26.00 per unit, with unit cost of SAR 9.50, yielding 63.2% gross margin.
coverage_notes: Menu data: 19 items with unit costs
Refunds excluded from net revenue and profit calculations
Unit costs sourced from menu.unit_cost_sar (declared supplier costs)
assumptions: Menu unit_cost_sar represents actual COGS per unit
POS line_total_sar is accurate and consistent
No recipe/BOM data available; per-drink ingredient costs not calculated
Waste costs not included in item-level COGS (only in inventory waste tracking)

findings.title: Quantified Waste Cost Impact
findings.claim: Known waste cost in analysis period totals SAR 1093.60 across 184 units, representing 5.89% of revenue from affected items. This is a direct margin pressure from non-saleable inventory.
coverage_notes: Only non-null waste_cost_sar values included (known waste only)
Inventory records: 6 items with waste cost data
Blank waste values treated as unknown, not zero
assumptions: Inventory waste_cost_sar accurately reflects disposal/loss value
Waste occurred during analysis period (week_starting date used as proxy)
No recipe/BOM data; cannot allocate waste to specific drink types

findings.title: Supplier Price Change Announcement: full-fat milk
findings.claim: Email from orders@qatifdairy.com announces full-fat milk price change from SAR 7.10 to SAR 8.40 per L (+18.31%), announced for future implementation on 2026-05-01. Email receipt status: unknown. Supplier relationship and standing order applicability not independently verified. Impact on cafe margins cannot be quantified without standing order volume data and recipe/BOM information.
coverage_notes: Email receipt status: unknown (not confirmed in cafe systems)
Supplier identity and standing order applicability not confirmed in structured data
No recipe/BOM data available to calculate per-drink cost impact
Standing order volume not available in email or structured data
Effective date 2026-05-01 is after analysis period 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-16
This finding documents a supplier communication for reference only; it does not represent a confirmed cost change affecting historical operations
assumptions: Email sender is authoritative supplier (not independently verified)
Price change applies to cafe's standing orders (not confirmed)
Standing order volume remains constant (actual volume unknown)
No recipe/BOM data; cannot calculate per-drink margin impact
Email receipt and acknowledgment by cafe not confirmed
Effective date temporal relationship to analysis period is as stated
